personality_one_liner: A cinematic, dark luxury experience evoking an exclusive brushed-metal membership card with sharp chrome typography and electric blue accents.

spacing.rule: Use generous margins around panels to emphasize the dark canvas. Inner padding of cards should feel premium (md to lg).

do's: Use subtle expo-blur on bottom sheet backdrops
Apply glass effect to the segmented control background if scrolling content goes underneath
dont's: Do not over-blur; the metal texture and solid dark shapes should remain the primary visual element

screens.name: Rank Predictor Tab
screens.purpose: Provides the user with a luxurious, dark-themed rank prediction and college shortlist experience.

states.error: Silver serif error text with a Royal Blue Retry button.

screens.layout: Header -> Segmented Switches -> Input Panel -> Rank Card -> Top College-Branch List. Use expo-linear-gradient for a faint navy glow behind the Rank Card area.

instructions_to_main_agent: NO IMAGES OR CUSTOM FONTS: Rely purely on 'Georgia' for iOS/Web and 'serif' for Android, system sans-serif for body, and vector-icons.

PANEL TREATMENT: Raised panels use surfaceSecondary (#121218). Section titles inside panels must use an electric blue hairline border (e.g., borderLeftWidth: 2, borderColor: '#2563EB') with silver, widely tracked uppercase serif text (letterSpacing: 2).
RANK CARD THEME: Brushed metal dark charcoal, silver serif CRL, blue hairline rule, tracked caps percentile, and a subtle electric blue glow (#1E3A8A) using expo-linear-gradient behind it.
CHIP DESIGN (NEUTRAL): Background surfaceTertiary (#1B1B24), text onSurfaceTertiary (#D1D2DA), border #272735.
CHIP DESIGN (TINTED / CHANCE): Safe (bg #064E3B, text #6EE7B7), Likely (bg #78350F, text #FDE68A), Borderline (bg #7F1D1D, text #FECACA).
SEGMENTED SWITCHES: Background surfaceTertiary (#1B1B24), active thumb uses surface (#0A0A0E) with borderStrong (#3B82F6) outline, inactive text muted (#8A8B9D), active text onSurface (#E3E4E8).
BOTTOM SHEETS: Background surfaceSecondary (#121218), drag handle muted (#8A8B9D). Table highlighted cells use a dark emerald (success bg #064E3B).
